name: Jump
levelText: alchemist 1, arcanist 1, bloodrager 1, druid 1, hunter 1, investigator 1, magus 1, psychic 1, ranger 1, redmantisassassin 1, sorcerer 1, summoner 1, summoner (unchained) 1, wizard 1
componentsText: V, S, M (a grasshopper's hind leg)
description: The subject gets a +10 enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks made to attempt high jumps or long jumps. The enhancement bonus increases to +20 at caster level 5th, and to +30 (the maximum) at caster level 9th.
